name: Meteor Swarm

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 PHB; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

targets.description: four 40-foot-radius Spheres (one Sphere per casting on the grid)

summary: Four 40-foot-radius blasts: Dex save, 20d6 Fire and 20d6 Bludgeoning damage, half on a success.
text: Meteors strike four points you can see in range; each creature within 40 feet of a point makes a Dexterity save, taking 20d6 Fire and 20d6 Bludgeoning damage on a failure or half on a success. A creature in several blasts is affected once, and unattended objects take the damage too (flammable ones ignite).
